ADDED i2: A reference Pax date used by several tests; epoch day 146096 lies in the Current Era.
ADDED i3: Applying a ZoneOffset (which carries the OFFSET_SECONDS field) as a TemporalAdjuster to a PaxDate is unsupported and must be rejected.
ADDED i5: range(MONTH_OF_YEAR) returns a valid (non-null) value range.
ADDED i6: range(DAY_OF_MONTH) returns a valid (non-null) value range.
ADDED i7: range(ALIGNED_WEEK_OF_YEAR) returns a valid (non-null) value range.
ADDED i8: range(DAY_OF_YEAR) returns a valid (non-null) value range.
ADDED i9: range(ALIGNED_WEEK_OF_MONTH) returns a valid (non-null) value range.
ADDED i10: In the Current Era the proleptic year equals the year-of-era.
ADDED i11: In the Before-Current Era the proleptic year is 1 - yearOfEra (here 1 - 99 = -98).
ADDED i12: plusYears returns a new, distinct PaxDate instance.
ADDED i13: Year 99 is a leap year because its last two digits are 99.
ADDED i14: dateNow with a null zone is rejected with a NullPointerException.
ADDED i16: Era value 0 maps to the Before-Current Era.
ADDED i17: The chronology id is reported as "Pax".
ADDED i18: A ZonedDateTime can be converted into a Pax zoned date-time.
ADDED i19: Building a date with an out-of-range month (-1093) is rejected.
ADDED i21: Resolving an empty field map yields no date (null).
ADDED i22: dateYearDay with year-of-era 0 produces a date in the Before-Current Era.
ADDED i23: dateYearDay rejects an era that is not a PaxEra.
ADDED i25: The Pax calendar has exactly two eras (CE and BCE).
ADDED i26: dateNow(clock) using a present-day clock returns a date in the Current Era.
ADDED i27: A small positive epoch day resolves to a date in the Current Era.
ADDED i28: date(era,...) rejects a null era (it is not a PaxEra).
ADDED i30: The calendar type is reported as "pax".
